GENERATION_1_CONTRACT.were_repeated_mask_bytes_distinguished_f: YES -- G1_PRECURSOR_MASK_IDENTITY_48_OF_48 requires the mask pair to be byte-identical WITHIN a quartet by construction, while PRECURSOR_DISTINCT_ACROSS_ANCESTRIES gives 12 distinct precursors with max multiplicity 1; the panel verification checks the two separately and both PASS
GENERATION_1_CONTRACT.alert_root_cause: PhaseLedger.publish_raw emitted the row-terminal state VERIFIED once per DECLARED OUTPUT; every construction row declares two (d_<did>.npz and m_<did>.npz). verify_monotone folds all records of a run_id into one sequence, so output 2's RAW_SEALED appears to move the row backwards from output 1's VERIFIED.
GENERATION_1_CONTRACT.why_the_weakness_is_real: PhaseLedger.decide reads VERIFIED as 'row finished', so a row killed between output 1's VERIFIED and output 2's publication would have been SKIPPED as complete on resume, leaving a charged row with an unpublished declared output. That window never opened in this phase, but the defect is exactly the line-resumability class FCDDH01R existed to eliminate.
GENERATION_1_CONTRACT.why_it_was_missed_prestart: every DEX row built by mkrows declared exactly ONE output; with one output, per-output VERIFIED and row-terminal VERIFIED are indistinguishable. The harness was blind to row ARITY, and the real phases are the only place arity is 2.

GENERATION_2_CONTRACT.remedy: publish_raw split into seal_output (RAW_SEALED) and publish_sealed (RAW_PUBLISHED); neither is terminal. _publish_all seals every declared output, then publishes every declared output, then emits exactly one row-terminal VERIFIED. os.replace is still never used on a final path.
